quotes.name: Ollie Campbell
quotes.quote: I don't follow the Oaks too close, but 23 points sounds like Adash did his job. Maybe ask why the rest of the team couldn't back him up—seems like a one-man show out there.

quotes.name: Guadalupe Lupe
quotes.quote: I heard about Adash's stats, but something feels off when a player puts up numbers like that and the team still loses. Maybe the Tribune should ask if he's really fitting into the team's system or just playing for himself.

claim: I don't follow the Oaks too close, but 23 points sounds like Adash did his job. Maybe ask why the rest of the team couldn't back him up—seems like a one-man show out there.
